method.timing: cuda event per launch, max over 4 ranks, palindromic ABBA, warmup 2, 6 rounds (12 samples/arm)
method.accuracy_gate: randn inputs, full-tensor compare vs FP32 reference: calc_diff <= 1e-3, cos_sim >= 0.999, all finite, repeat/stress diff <= 1e-3, exact expert stats
method.significance: robust MAD z; positive needs delta <= -1% and z <= -3
